name: tnef
why: Unpacks the obscure Microsoft TNEF attachment format, a small but real look into an odd proprietary file format.

brief.what_it_is: TNEF is a command-line program that unpacks MIME attachments of type "application/ms-tnef", the Microsoft-specific TNEF container that Outlook and Exchange wrap around some mail. It takes a TNEF attachment as input and extracts the files that were packed inside it. The README says the tool is mainly tested on GNU/Linux and Cygwin and should work on other UNIX-like systems. The installed executable is named tnef.
brief.why_it_exists: The README says that because so many Outlook and Exchange servers produce this format, more mail is wrapped in it, and the tool lets people open those attachments without using Microsoft Outlook.
brief.how_it_works: The README does not explain the internals. It describes the program as unpacking the files encapsulated inside a TNEF attachment. It also warns that TNEF does not handle attachments with non-Unicode filenames or data well.

commands_seen.context: First step of the source build, run before configure to generate the build system.
Configures the source build for the local system.
Builds the tnef executable in the src directory and runs the unit tests.
Installs tnef, which the README says goes into /usr/local/bin.
Shows the command-line options, as an alternative to the man page.

brief.install_notes: The README gives a source build with no Homebrew-specific steps: run autoreconf, then ./configure, then make check, then make install. The full instructions are in a separate INSTALL file, which I did not read. Building from source needs autotools available, since the first step is autoreconf. The README does not mention any accounts, runtimes, or configuration.
brief.standout: This is a small, single-purpose tool for a proprietary Microsoft format that most people never see directly. It is a plain C-style autotools project with a man page and unit tests run by make check, a fairly old-school setup.
brief.status: unknown. The README has no release date, changelog, or note about maintenance. The only evidence is a Travis CI badge pointing at travis-ci.org, which I did not check, so I cannot say when the project was last active.
brief.caveats: The README says TNEF does not handle well attachments with non-Unicode filenames or data. It is mainly tested on GNU/Linux and Cygwin, and other UNIX-like systems are not confirmed. Installation requires building from source with autotools, not just running a package. The license is in a COPYING file that I did not read, so I have not confirmed the terms.
quotes: TNEF is a program for unpacking MIME attachments of type "application/ms-tnef". This is a Microsoft only attachment.
Due to the proliferation of Microsoft Outlook and Exchange mail servers, more and more mail is encapsulated into this format.
Caveat: TNEF does not handle well attachments with non-Unicode filenames or data.
